summary: KKR Infrastructure Conglomerate LLC filed a routine Form 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting Item 8.01 Other Events — the manager's determination of the transactional net asset value per share for its share classes as of August 31, 2026. Class U $30.88, Class R $30.95, Class D $30.87, Class I-Series 1 $30.90, Class S $30.88, Class F $32.93, Class G and Class H $37.06. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, premium, or deal terms were disclosed; this is an ordinary interval-fund NAV update, not a special situation.
